newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rexrodt sees Q2 growth of one pct from pvs year.
newsitem.headline: Rexrodt sees Q2 growth of one pct from pvs year.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Friday that the economy probably grew around one percent in the second quarter of 1996 from the same quarter a year ago.

"Although no official data are yet available from the Federal Statistics Office the upward development is increasingly confirmed by the facts at hand," Rexrodt said in a statement ahead of a news conference in Bonn.
Rexrodt sees Q2 growth of one pct from pvs =2

The economy also grew significantly in the second quarter when compared to the first three months of 1996, Rexrodt said, adding that he expected the economy to continue to expand moderately in the second half of the year.

Commenting on the prospects for growth in the longer-term, Rexrodt predicted pan-German gross domestic product would grow around 0.75 percent this year and between two percent and 2.5 percent next year.
